text:
sam (sales): Oliver on a live demo, hitting 403s intermittently on /v1/generate. Customer waiting, need fast triage.

ina (sales-eng): Hi Oliver, can you paste the exact curl and the full error body? 403 usually org or project binding.

oliver (customer): Curl: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer SK-DEMO-9xy" -H "X-Tenant-Id: tenant-42" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"summarize"}'``` Error: {"error":"access_denied","detail":"key bound to tenant-11"}

jordan (platform): auth-bot, inspect SK-DEMO-9xy please.

auth-bot: token-inspect: SK-DEMO-9xy -> bound_tenant: tenant-11, scopes: [generate,chat], created_by: sales-quickstart, expires_in: 86400s

ina (sales-eng): Looks like the token is bound to tenant-11 but header says tenant-42. If header present and mismatched we return 403. Two options: remove header or issue a token for tenant-42. Which do you want for the demo?

oliver (customer): The dashboard shows tenant-42. We joined via the trial link—could that have created a separate tenant?

sam (sales): That happens sometimes if you join from a different email. Quick check: run `GET /v1/account/keys` with the token to see bound_tenant.

oliver (customer): Running... shows bound_tenant: tenant-11. If I remove X-Tenant-Id the call succeeds.

jordan (platform): For the demo, drop the header. For a longer POC, we should issue a tenant-42 key. I can mint a short-lived key now.

jordan (platform): auth-bot: issue temp key TK-T42-DEMO scope=generate bound_tenant=tenant-42 expires=3600

auth-bot: issued: TK-T42-DEMO (generate) bound_tenant=tenant-42 expires_in=3600s

oliver (customer): New token works, demo back on. Thanks!

sam (sales): Quick pricing question from the call: Oliver, are you planning light demo traffic or heavier embedding workloads?

oliver (customer): Light demo, maybe later eval with embeddings.

pricing-bot: Estimated demo hosted cost ~ $0.30 / 30 min for generate. Embeddings pricing attached: https://redwood.ai/pricing/embeddings

nina (sales-eng): Follow-ups: 1) jordan to offer a permanent tenant-42 key if they proceed, 2) sam to send pricing/email and procurement contact, 3) nina to own security questionnaire handoff.

docs-bot: Note for eng: several support threads suggest adding the token's bound_tenant to the access_denied error payload to reduce back-and-forth. Filing a docs/ux item.

jordan (platform): Logged internal ticket INF-273: return bound_tenant in 403 payload (mask actual token id). Also will add a short troubleshooting snippet to the SDK docs about header vs token binding.

oliver (customer): Will DM the security form. Appreciate the rapid help.

sam (sales): Great job team :thumbsup: Closing this thread, will attach SOC2 and the issued key details in the ticket.
